title: Whispering Whelk Waltz
statement: A small, translucent whelk carries a lantern of soft amber light inside its spiral shell, and it spends its evenings slowly waltzing in circles around a stack of mossy teacups. Each time it completes a turn, it lets out a tiny 'shhhh' of bubbles, as if telling the sleepy ferns and the pebbles to hush and listen.
